name: @bitcd/core
description: bitcd core library — the reusable half of the governed-KV control plane: protocol constants, contract client + SNIP-12 intent signing, the reconcile engine (executor), the fleet voter engine + peer-daemon shell, the hash-chained evidence log, the verify-on-read blob store, the deploy/bootstrap ceremony, the event-stream folds, and the org declaration: the bitcd/v1 schema and its compiler, the governed org manifest (orgmanifest/v1) with its verify-on-read loader, the proposal side channel, and the bitcd CLI (bin/bitcd.mjs). The Cairo contract itself lives in contracts/ (a standalone Scarb package); this package embeds its compiled artifacts. Demo fixtures, devnet accounts, and use-case schemas deliberately live OUTSIDE this package (e2e/, and the sibling product repos).
